user_decision.label: Candidate-attached status, subsection arrivals, and Staging-local alert

surface.operation: one fixed status line inside the affected final-type Node card or Bit row
surface.remote_arrival: separate actionable indicator beside only the affected Nodes or Bits heading
surface.terminal_alert: one static band directly below the Staging title and above both subsection wells
surface.target_reason: attached only to the currently active neutral or invalid Staging well or target
prohibited: alert stack, queue, history, or carousel

count_and_remote_arrival.base_count: Nodes and Bits remain bare at zero or one and use the durable total prefix only at two or more
count_and_remote_arrival.arrival_effect: preserve scroll and focus without mutation
count_and_remote_arrival.activation: revalidate, scroll the affected subsection to top, clear its count, and focus the first surviving new candidate without starting a drag or mutation
count_and_remote_arrival.empty_revalidation: focus the affected subsection heading when no new candidate survives
count_and_remote_arrival.observed_top: clear the count without moving focus
count_and_remote_arrival.clear: activation, authoritative top observation, Scratch change, or Inbox route exit/reload

stage_pending.shape: final semantic Node card or Bit row projection

unstage_pending.shape: retain exact durable candidate and position

stage_unknown.copy: We couldn’t confirm whether “{title}” was staged.

unstage_unknown.copy: We couldn’t confirm whether “{title}” was returned.

stage_not_applied.copy: “{title}” was not staged. Drag it again to retry.
stage_not_applied.action: Dismiss Staging alert only; retry is a new drag

stage_rejected.copy: “{title}” can’t be staged from its current source.

stage_conflict.copy: “{title}” changed elsewhere and was not staged.

unstage_not_applied.copy: “{title}” is still staged. Drag it back to Breakdown to retry.
unstage_not_applied.action: Dismiss Staging alert only; retry is a new drag

unstage_rejected.copy: “{title}” can’t be returned from its current state.

source_unresolved.presentation: type-shaped integrity status, never a normal draggable candidate
source_unresolved.boundary: cache miss, offline, and delayed subscription never use orphan wording

confirmed_orphan.copy: A staged {Node|Bit} was removed because its source no longer exists.
confirmed_orphan.presentation: terminal alert after authoritative proof and atomic cleanup
confirmed_orphan.title_boundary: never reconstruct an unavailable source title or candidate label snapshot

invalidated_drag.effect: retain visual snapshot only through release, suppress mutation, then apply authority

invalidated_placement.effect: close stale placement under the existing headless contract

target_reason_matrix.opposite_type: Return to Breakdown before changing type.
target_reason_matrix.invalid_source_or_target: This item is no longer available.
target_reason_matrix.lifetime: active target only; clear on target exit or drag end
target_reason_matrix.mutation: same-type release is mutation-free cancel; invalid release writes nothing

alert.action_effect: close only current alert and perform no mutation
alert.replacement: a later failure replaces the prior alert
alert.clear: X, a new operation for that candidate, authoritative candidate disappearance, or Scratch switch
alert.focus_after_dismiss: surviving candidate root, otherwise related Breakdown source, otherwise Staging heading
alert.success: ordinary Stage uses staged state; authoritative Unstage success delegates to DP-VQ02 and creates no alert or toast

focus_and_accessibility.automatic_updates: status, remote arrival/removal, source resolution, and alert replacement never steal focus
focus_and_accessibility.announcement: announce each newly entered operation or alert sentence once through one polite atomic status; never announce rerender or elapsed time
focus_and_accessibility.pending_focus: retain the logical operation source or candidate focus
focus_and_accessibility.orphan_announcement: announce once only after authoritative proof and cleanup

motion.ordinary: all candidate-line, indicator, alert, target-reason, scroll, and focus changes are immediate
motion.prohibited: fade, slide, scale, spinner, pulse, ping, bounce, blink, flicker, and layout-transition animation
motion.reduced_motion: identical geometry, copy, controls, timing, focus, and lifetime

theme_mapping.griddo: candidate technical rule, compact subsection count chip, restrained semantic alert band, and canonical action/focus roles
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: paper-object annotation, stationery count tab, and ruled-paper notice below the wood/cork title
theme_mapping.neumorphism: shallow inset candidate line, named raised count action, and wide inset alert well within the existing shadow family
theme_mapping.claymorphism: shape-preserving candidate seam, puffy non-color count, and soft sculpted alert ribbon
theme_mapping.origami: candidate fold-edge status, folded count tab, and attached alert strip with seam-separated action
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven inline record status, text count command, and static framed alert with no fixed JSX color or blink
theme_mapping.retro-mac: in-place 1-bit candidate footer, hard counter control, and full-width alert pane below the title with no new window
theme_mapping.graphite: candidate editorial caption, compact index count, and strengthened-rule alert band with restrained monochrome action

implementation_boundary.excludes: Tasks 145-146 headless behavior, repository commands, operation locks, reconciliation, candidate truth, DP-VQ02, D-CARD, product implementation in Task 112, and every Pool/Explorer state or realization

exact_release.consumption_condition: Task 112 user checkpoint accepted; its plan marker remains open until then
